'''Outworlder City''', also known as '''Dry Ground''', '''Safe At Last''', '''Sanity''', and '''Oorlglush''' in the [[Ergesh language]], was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]], the [[Ergesh]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], built for off-worlders in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].

Outworlder City was built on huge metal supports that raised it above the soggy terrain. It was protected by a transparent dome from the [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]] hot and humid climate. Inside the dome the humidity level was kept at a comfortable level and the temperature at a constant 20 degree [[Standard (temperature)|standard]]. A small [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] was located just outside the dome, where a mechanical monorail shuttled people back and forth.

The city contained usual facilities vital to [[Spacer/Legends|spacefarers]], sush as [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], restaurants, medical facilities, equipment shops, [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] and hotels. Several galactic corporations had offices in the city including [[Loprana Soil-Enrichers]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] embassy in the city was headed by [[Arvin Tadle]].
